**Aetheria Academy** — A modern, responsive school website concept with interactive components.

### Structure
```
./
├── index.html    (846 lines) — Main HTML structure
├── style.css     (700+ lines) — Complete styling system
├── script.js     (400+ lines) — Interactive behaviors
└── assets/

```

### Key Sections (index.html)
| Section | ID | Features |
|---------|----|----------|
| Header/Nav | — | Logo, nav links, theme toggle, mobile menu, CTA |
| Hero | `#hero-section` | Animated stats, floating card, campus image |
| Core Values | `#about` | 3 feature cards (Tech, Global, Creative) |
| Curriculum | `#curriculum` | **Tabbed interface** (STEM/Humanities/Arts) with images |
| Tuition Calculator | `#calculator` | **Interactive form** — grade slider, housing toggle, elective checkboxes, scholarship dropdown, live cost breakdown |
| Portal Demo | `#portal` | **4-tab mock dashboard** — Grades (bar charts), Schedule, Homework (checkable), Announcements |
| Gallery | `#gallery` | 3-image grid with hover overlays |
| Testimonials | `#testimonials` | **Carousel** with prev/next controls |
| Contact | `#contact` | Info cards + validated inquiry form with success overlay |
| Footer | — | Nav grids, compliance disclaimer (TRL 1-2), social links |

### CSS Architecture (style.css)
- **CSS Custom Properties** for theming (light/dark modes)
- **Fluid typography** with `clamp()`
- **Layout utilities**: `.container`, `.section-padding`, `.grid` variants
- **Component classes**: `.btn`, `.card`, `.form-input`, `.feature-card`, `.curriculum-tab`, `.choice-box`, `.portal-pane`, `.gallery-item`, `.testimonial-slide`
- **Animations**: `@keyframes` for fade-in, slide-up, glow-pulse, spinner, counter
- **Responsive breakpoints**: 1024px, 768px, 480px
- **Reduced motion** support via `prefers-reduced-motion`

### JavaScript Modules (script.js)
| Module | Responsibility |
|--------|----------------|
| `ThemeManager` | Light/dark toggle + localStorage persistence |
| `MobileNav` | Hamburger menu + body scroll lock |
| `SmoothScroll` | Header-offset anchor navigation |
| `CounterAnimation` | IntersectionObserver-driven number counting |
| `CurriculumTabs` | Tab switching with ARIA attributes |
| `TuitionCalculator` | Real-time cost calculation (slider, segments, checkboxes, select) |
| `PortalTabs` | 4-tab portal dashboard switching |
| `TestimonialCarousel` | Auto-play (5s) + manual controls + pause on hover |
| `ContactForm` | Validation, submit simulation, success overlay, tracking ID generation |
| `ScrollReveal` | IntersectionObserver fade-in for `.reveal` elements |
| `initAll()` | Bootstraps all modules on `DOMContentLoaded` |

### Notable Implementation Details
- **Accessibility**: ARIA roles (`tablist`, `tab`, `radiogroup`, `checkbox`, `dialog`), `aria-label`, `aria-checked`, `aria-selected`, focus styles
- **No external dependencies** — vanilla ES6 modules pattern
- **Simulation disclaimer** in footer (TRL 1-2) — all data is hypothetical
- **Images** referenced from `/assets/` (3 JPGs present)

### Potential Areas for Enhancement
1. **File size** — `index.html` at 846 lines exceeds 500-line guideline; could split into partials
2. **Image optimization** — No WebP/AVIF fallbacks or `srcset`
3. **Form backend** — Currently simulates submit; would need API endpoint
4. **Carousel** — No keyboard navigation (arrow keys) or swipe support
5. **Calculator** — Hardcoded base tuition ($18,000); could externalize to config

---
